title: Constraint: Magic Square
constraints: Fill a 3 × 3 square with 1 … 9, each exactly once, so that every row, column and both diagonals add up to **15**. Different calls should produce different squares (8 exist).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Element values are 4 bits wide. Make sure sums are computed in a wider type (`int'(…)` on the first term widens the whole expression).
Uniqueness: pairwise inequalities over the flattened index.
All 8 solutions are rotations and reflections of one square, so the solver should find several of them.

examples.check: all rows, columns and both diagonals sum to 15
examples.title: magic
